name: ChimplyVR
summary: Immerse yourself in the ultimate Gorilla Tag fan experience! This game brings high-energy, physics-based movement to VR, letting you run, jump, and climb using only your arms. Explore diverse maps, unlock unique cosmetics, and challenge yourself in thrilling tag-based game modes. Whether you're evading capture or hunting down your friends, every match is a heart-pounding test of skill. With frequent updates and a vibrant community, there's always something new to discover. Get ready to go wild—play now!
